name: tracker-loop
enabledWhen: queue non-empty (the bot pauses it when the queue is empty and resumes it on a new request)
steps: Work only in <wt> for fleet files; the thin routine prompt has already loaded the rules and bots/<me>/state.json.
Pull <queue-clone> (your private queue repo <queue-repo>) and check every open request in queue.json (a JSON array) in one pass.

Carrier requests: follow bots/<me>/skills/live-package-tracking/SKILL.md and the status-source chain in rules.md, in order, stopping at the first fresh status: (1) the carrier's official API if a key is configured; (2) the carrier's public tracking page in a real browser via a browser/computerUse subagent (don't retry shell calls that 403); (3) a cached tracking site over HTTP, labelled cached since it may lag; (4) carrier alert emails in the bot inbox; (5) a read-only search of the user's email notifications, last resort. Never wait on email when (1) or (2) works.
Convert scan times to <timezone>. Store lastStatus with its source and scan time, and include both in every report; note in memory.md any source that started failing.

End any request that hit its expected status, maxChecks or expiresAt: report the result (final status, check count, why it ended, plus any found value) to its requester bot(s) only, as a priority message; remove it, and put id, requester and result in the commit message.
Commit and push the queue only if the file changed. If the queue is empty, pause this routine.
Stay silent otherwise. Never message the user directly.
